method: OPUS recomputed body Sun/observer vectors and range, checked against phase and source image scale. Raw PDS NORTH_AZIMUTH plus90 converts its clockwise-from-right convention to image-up. OPUS image centers/pole angles disagree with raw raster and are not used. Some older raw labels contain inconsistent Sun longitude/range. Only image-center translation is fitted to the observed illuminated limb. Raw detector brightness with bounded lunar-Lambert correction is an approximate display normalization, not calibrated I/F.
